excerpts_parent_transcribed: THIS IS NOT A LOWER BOUND. Measuring that a tested solver set does not prune is not a proof that no solver can. Every statement is scoped to the solvers, versions, encodings and orders actually run, and the record must not be cited as "SAT cannot do better on the pdp".

The observable cannot distinguish the Semaev system from a shape-matched random system; that is asserted here and tested by IDEA-20260904-b40e6d. Until that null runs, NOTHING in this record may be described as a property of elliptic curves.

excerpts_parent_transcribed: AGREEMENT IS NOT ABSENCE. A controlled null says the observable does not distinguish, at these parameters, with this power. It does not say no curve-specific structure exists, and the record must not be cited that way.

This record makes no claim about WDSat, which has not been fetched or built in this repository, and no claim about any number in SRC-SATIC-TRIMOSKA-2019, which are the authors’ own and are not reproduced here.

NO STATEMENT ABOUT WDSat OR WDSatGE, neither of which has been fetched or built here. Where a GE-enabled solver is used it is named and pinned.
